agent_explanation: Oblique heavy-light circle-circle collision injects energy. At step 5 bodies are separate with normal energy ~1509 J; at step 6 they are just touching (gap 0.0018) but heavy body 0 (16.3 kg) jumped from vx -6.4 to +43.7 m/s and system energy to 17706 J with zero controller work. X-momentum jumps from ~-76 to ~+738 kg m/s, so the impulse/positional correction massively over-impulses. Setting e=0 still violates (8699 J), ruling out restitution, while equal masses passes, pointing to inverted/swapped mass weighting in the impulse (effective mass) for large mass ratios combined with deep penetration in one substepped step.
